rough_filter: snapshot names containing common stock, case insensitive
matching: uppercase symbol with dot changed to hyphen; exact accession/context matching
limitations: This is a rough name filter and is not a verified common-stock universe.
A ticker match and a single observed CIK do not establish identity, listing eligibility, class, or continuous ticker validity.
Exchange and title are as reported in selected 2021 filings, not independently confirmed as of the comparison date.
Multiple strings can reflect spelling differences, distinct classes, stale filings or changed listings.
The SEC archives are retrospective; snapshot source timing and data-use rights remain unverified.
No return or investment-growth target was computed.
